notes.title: 🎊《V-LOVER！》Surpassed 160,000 sales! 🎊
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/b5d80fd717ccd9f1ae1cd938a0712eef388e795b.gif[/img]

[h2][b]From the Lewd Loco × Hentopia team, our heartfelt thanks![/b][/h2]
In just two months,《V-LOVER！》has attracted over 160,000 producers to join this joyful (and lewd?) entertainment adventure!

100,000 was a milestone, but 160,000 is an incredible acceleration—thank you for your support, sharing, and streaming, which have pushed this crazy project even further.


[h2][b]🙏 Apology to players who encountered bugs[/b][/h2]
We are aware that during gameplay, some players encountered issues such as the settings menu being inoperable, as well as other irregular problems that affected the overall experience. For this, we sincerely apologize.
The game has already gone through multiple version updates, fixing most of the reported issues, and has now reached v0.1.09.

Thank you to everyone who shared feedback in the community and discussion boards!

https://steamcommunity.com/games/3044740/announcements/detail/547871324002846840?snr=2___

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3044740/VTuber/

notes.title: 《Dark Lord Leona》Demo store page is live! Are you ready to offer your essence to the Queen?
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3950040/_Demo/
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/43a162320be1d0415e6d3cc3195bdb89ae1f247a.gif[/img]


[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/d1edcb93944655800187db0b9f754ccea1353bd4.jpg[/img]
666 years after the extermination of the demon race, the Demon King's daughter, Leona, awakens and resolves to execute the "Demon Instrumentality". This plan involves seeking powerful genes across various nations, engaging in reproduction, and giving birth to potent hybrid offspring to dominate these nations, ultimately spreading demon influence across the world.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/c49b5e9aaf564dc275ebd36ad39efd57d474a45f.png[/img]


[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/07c87a94d07e281aae5d60a6238a1fbfe17dfb60.jpg[/img]
Dark Lord Leona is a fast-paced card strategy game where you strategize and combine your playstyle each turn to crush your enemies.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/345ae8ee80c9313a4afd86ab878ce680e2cdbc8f.png[/img]


[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/52f05319abe565eb3ade695d51866728631756e5.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] The game features 10 costumes that can be switched, each with different skills.
[*] Card Rogue, constantly switching and building different playstyles to battle enemies.
[*] 12 sets of dynamic CGs.
[*] 22 talent skills.
[/list]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/c42830247aa101bd9a060288cc05ef53c203e21d.png[/img]
